post.description: Email-only provisioning is NOT identity verification. Explicit local demo environment only; production returns 403. Credential or magic-link flow deferred.

delete.x-idempotency: Revocation is repeatable, including absent or invalid cookies.

get.description: At most 50 results ordered by startsAt then id ascending. meta.total is returned row count, not all matching rows. No cursor or client limit yet. Unknown query fields are rejected.

post.x-authorization: Active owner/admin membership of organizationId, or superadmin. Session verification required; no demo header bypass.

post.description: Sequential duplicate email/event requests return 200 with existing pass. Public registration; userId is legacy untrusted input and a known reconciliation finding. Capacity serialization and duplicate pass disclosure need policy/technical resolution.
post.x-idempotency: Natural key: event ID plus lowercase trimmed email. Sequential retries only; concurrent replay behavior incomplete.

post.description: Sandbox only. Event must exist and be approved, paid, with a valid server-priced tier. No inventory reservation, organizer authorization or client idempotency yet; not production ready.

Signature verified on raw body; livemode=true rejected. Durable event-ID deduplication exists but claim-before-processing and partial writes are unresolved. No real ticket fulfillment, refund reversal or reservation release.
post.x-idempotency: Stripe event ID in D1; failure retry and concurrent claim correctness remain blockers.

get.description: Internal only. All pending events ordered createdAt descending. Unbounded legacy queue, no pagination. Middleware 401 uses text/html.
get.x-authorization: Verified Access identity or explicit emergency credential at middleware. Domain staff role lookup not implemented.

post.description: Internal only. revision_requested currently becomes rejected; this is a documented semantic mismatch pending workflow decision. Audit and moderation writes are not atomic.
post.x-authorization: Access boundary only. Access subject is not mapped to D1 reviewer user; domain permission verification deferred.

BrowserSession.name: __session
BrowserSession.description: HMAC signed session ID verified against D1. Not proof of identity at session issuance.

CloudflareAccess.name: Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion
CloudflareAccess.description: RS256 JWT verified against configured audience, issuer and JWKS. Staff application boundary, not domain RBAC.

StripeSignature.name: Stripe-Signature
StripeSignature.description: HMAC SHA256 over timestamp and exact raw request body. Replay tolerance enforced. Test events only.

EmergencyBearer.description: Conditional configured break-glass only; disabled by default in production.
